about: How uncertain kisi's results are, per accuracy level, from its own validation (docs/models.md, section Accuracy levels; design: docs/research/accuracy-levels.md). Uncertainties are typical deviations from the references (in percent of the value), not bounds: a number outside them is possible.

impedance.about: Impedance of a cross-section (single-ended, or the pair's differential impedance) by how it was computed.

sources.text: Field solver (field_pct): validation/cst_xs (620 cross-sections against CST Studio Suite's 2D port modes, README.md there) – kisi's field result as kisi reports it against CST's open-boundary estimate, without the etch group (trapezoids kisi does not model) and the 16 asymmetric pairs: Z0, Zdiff, Zeven median 0.18 %, p90 0.47 %, p99 0.78 %, max 1.03 %; pairs' Zdiff median 0.48 %, p90 0.80 %. Earlier: Forstén's test suite against HFSS/Ansys within 1.7 % (tools/validate_field.sh).

Formulas (docs/models.md table, validation/thunderscope_xs.json): single microstrip +1.4 %, HFSS microstrip −0.6 %; diff microstrip +5.6 / +7.8 %; asymmetric stripline +10.3 %, 3D stripline T_ts6_sl +11 % (validation/fdtd/results/kisi_models.json); over a cut-out up to 25 % (flag F_FORMULA_ROUGH, extract.rs).

Coplanar formula (formula_coplanar_pct; surface microstrip with coplanar copper, analytic::microstrip_cpwg): validation/cst_xs, the 104 single-ended cases with coplanar copper and no plane opening (groups cpwg, anchor, size_study, board_target, board_other, test_board) against CST's open-boundary estimate – median 0.9 %, p90 1.7 %, max 2.7 % (before the coplanar formula: median 4.9 %, p90 8.8 %, max 28 %). Pairs with coplanar ground keep formula_coupled_pct (Zdiff median 2.2 %, p90 3.6 %, 13 cases), striplines with coplanar ground formula_stripline_pct (median 0.6 %, p90 1.6 %, 22 cases; offset striplines carry the plain stripline's error).
No plane (coplanar return, analytic::no_plane): gold-finger cases of validation/fdtd/TESTS.md section 15 – single fingers within about 8 %, the pair without any plane about 15 % low.

vias.about: Via models against the 3D references: error of the impedance in the 25 ps TDR (minimum and maximum), median and 90th percentile.

sources.text: validation/fdtd/results/kisi_models.json (compare_kisi.py, tools/golden.py vias; kisi's channel, the via de-embedded with kisi's own 2×thru against the 3D references of kisi-fdtd, refined mesh on the inner-layer exits, both with the matched de-embedding of every port, validation/fdtd/TESTS.md sections 17–19): ladder 2.43 / 5.13 % (29 single vias), pairs Zdiff 4.02 / 5.65 % (12 pairs); delay |Δτ| median 0.21 ps (single vias) / 0.18 ps (pairs). results/kisi_models_coax.json: coaxial fallback 8.0 / 25.5 % (a record of the former model against the former references).
